get.description:
Distinct category/packing_tag/vendor values for the items filter
menus — the whole list, not just the current page. Sync-free, same
reasoning as `items`.

Backs the detail page's table: search, the 3 filters, sort, group,
box-header/content adjacency and pagination, all server-side. Takes
get_object() rather than _synced_object() — this runs on every
keystroke/filter change/page turn, and re-syncing on each would
defeat the point of the optimistic-editing design.

A paged response also counts the rows the search and filters match
across every page, and how many of those are picked, which is what
"Mark all picked" acts on and what decides whether it reads "Unmark".

post.description:
Ticks (or, with picked false, unticks) every row the items table's
search and filters match, on every page. Reads those from the query
string, exactly as `items` does.
